name: Sunoh.ai
description: Sunoh.ai is an AI medical scribe serving 100,000+ providers at $149/month—making it one of the most affordable ambient AI options with EHR integration. Key differentiator: multi-language support enables providers to conduct visits and generate notes in multiple languages, valuable for practices serving diverse patient populations. Strategic partnership with eClinicalWorks provides deep integration, with Epic, Cerner, and athenahealth also supported. At $149/month with unlimited visits, Sunoh undercuts enterprise options like DeepScribe ($350+/mo) and Suki ($299/mo) while offering similar core functionality. Not built for mental health-specific documentation.

faqs.q: How much does Sunoh.ai cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Sunoh.ai costs $149/provider/month for unlimited visits with EHR integration. This makes it one of the most affordable ambient AI scribes—cheaper than DeepScribe ($350+/mo), Suki ($299/mo), and Heidi Clinician ($150/mo).
Yes. Multi-language support is a key differentiator—providers can conduct visits and generate notes in various languages. This is valuable for practices serving diverse patient populations.

faqs.q: What EHRs does Sunoh.ai integrate with?
faqs.a: Sunoh.ai has a strategic partnership with eClinicalWorks for deep integration. It also integrates with Epic, Cerner (Oracle Health), and athenahealth.

faqs.q: Is Sunoh.ai good for mental health practices?
faqs.a: No. Sunoh.ai is designed for primary care and medical specialties, not mental health-specific documentation. Therapists should use Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo). Psychiatrists should consider Freed ($39-119/mo).

faqs.q: Sunoh.ai vs Freed: which is better?
faqs.a: Both offer transparent pricing. Sunoh ($149/mo) includes multi-language support and deeper EHR integrations. Freed ($39-119/mo) is cheaper and handles psychiatry medication management. For pure cost savings, Freed wins. For multi-language needs, Sunoh wins.
